title: The 1905 mass-energy paper
summary: Einstein's 1905 paper argues that a body's mass is a measure of its energy content.
body: Later in 1905 Einstein published "Ist die Trägheit eines Körpers von seinem Energieinhalt abhängig?" The title asks whether the inertia of a body depends on its energy content. The relation people now write as E = mc² is the familiar form of that result. The paper is a derivation inside special relativity, not a laboratory report. Calling the equation a separate experimental fact, without naming a test, overstates what this document itself is.
